biggest_catch: Instacart's Instant Cashout is widely documented — but every source found is third-party. No official instacart.com/help page confirming payout terms surfaced, so it fails the official-terms-only rule.
catches: Third-party sources (NerdWallet, trybeem, ridesharingdriver) agree: weekly direct deposit (Wed–Fri) + Instant Cashout up to 5x/day ($0.50–$1.50 fee, $5 minimum, tips excluded) — but none of this is on an official Instacart page in the search results.
Spam/scraper sites (virtual.cteg.edu.py) dominate the results, indicating Instacart's own help content is not well-indexed.
Without official confirmation of amounts, fees, and timing, verification cannot proceed.

c1.evidence: Instacart is a real grocery-delivery platform, but no official-domain payout terms located.

c2.evidence: Payout facts (Instant Cashout 5x/day, $0.50-$1.50 fee, $5 min) reported only by third parties; not confirmed on instacart.com.

notes: Checked 2026-09-23. Instacart is legitimate and likely verifiable IF its official help center publishes shopper payout terms — revisit if an official help.instacart.com or instacart.com payout article is found. Aggregator-only claims do not qualify.
payout_value_note: third-party-reported Instant Cashout not officially confirmed
